title: Odia conjuncts display incorrectly in the terminal
symptom_summary: Printing Odia words in the integrated terminal produces malformed conjunct characters, including with extensions disabled.
repro_steps: Print an Odia word containing conjunct characters in the integrated terminal.

title: Unicode sample renders incorrectly with Cascadia Mono
symptom_summary: A Unicode sample displays some characters incorrectly in the VS Code terminal when using Cascadia Mono. The reporter says the same sample looks correct in Windows Terminal.
repro_steps: Install Cascadia Code 2404.23 and select Cascadia Mono.
Display the linked Unicode sample in the integrated terminal.

title: Command Prompt and PowerShell open to a blank terminal
symptom_summary: On one Windows machine, both Command Prompt and PowerShell 7 display an empty integrated terminal that accepts no commands.
repro_steps: Open Command Prompt or PowerShell 7 in the integrated terminal.
Try to enter a command.

title: Long Node.js launch command stops partway through terminal input
symptom_summary: Launching Node.js with a long PATH leaves the command partially entered. A project launch configuration with a shorter PATH works for the reporter.
repro_steps: Set a default PATH longer than 2048 characters.
Launch a Node.js instance through VS Code.

title: Terminal panel closes as soon as it is opened
symptom_summary: Opening the integrated terminal or its bottom panel causes it to close immediately. Selecting a different default terminal made no difference.
repro_steps: Open the integrated terminal or its bottom panel.

title: PowerShell terminal duplicates lines when resized
symptom_summary: Existing output lines appear twice after expanding and collapsing the integrated terminal view.
repro_steps: Print more lines than the visible area.
Expand and collapse the terminal view several times.

title: Ctrl+C does not interrupt Python in the integrated terminal
symptom_summary: Ctrl+C fails to interrupt a running Python process in the integrated terminal, while it works in the standalone macOS Terminal.
repro_steps: Run a Python process in the integrated terminal.
Press Ctrl+C.

title: Integrated terminal crashes on opening
symptom_summary: The reporter says the terminal crashes when opened. The report gives no error details.
repro_steps: Open the integrated terminal.

title: Terminal output is misaligned until the panel is resized
symptom_summary: Running a Python script produces misaligned terminal text. Dragging the panel boundary restores alignment.
repro_steps: Open the sidebar or panel and run a simple Python program.
Drag the panel boundary and observe whether the output realigns.

title: Terminal cannot find the PowerShell executable
symptom_summary: Opening a new terminal fails because the configured Windows PowerShell executable cannot be found.
error_message: Path to shell executable does not exist
repro_steps: Open a new terminal using the configured PowerShell executable.

title: Terminal stops accepting commands after running Dart
symptom_summary: After a few Dart commands, the terminal stops responding to further input.
repro_steps: Run several Dart commands in the terminal.
Try to enter another command.

title: Python terminal reactivation remains in progress
symptom_summary: VS Code keeps reactivating the terminals without making them usable for Python. The report includes an environment resolution error.

title: Drag-and-drop terminal split renders text twice
symptom_summary: After dragging one terminal tab beside another terminal's content, the split view renders terminal content twice.
repro_steps: Open two terminals.
Drag the first terminal tab to the right edge of the second terminal's content.

title: Empty terminal cannot run npm commands
symptom_summary: The integrated terminal appears blank, and the reporter cannot run npm commands from it.

title: Large input to a busy subprocess freezes all terminals
symptom_summary: Pasting long input into an unresponsive subprocess makes integrated terminals across VS Code windows freeze and triggers a PTY host warning.
repro_steps: Start an R session in the terminal.
Paste commands that pause R and send long input while it is busy.

title: Terminal accessibility buffer cannot reach earlier output
symptom_summary: Using NVDA, the reporter can read only the recent portion of long terminal output in the accessibility buffer.
repro_steps: Open the terminal accessibility buffer with Alt+F2 after generating long output.
Try to scroll back to the first line.

title: Large blank gaps appear after terminal commands
symptom_summary: The reporter sees excess vertical space between each command and its output after cleaning the Windows system.

title: Ubuntu WSL terminal profile does not work
symptom_summary: The built-in Ubuntu WSL profile fails for the reporter, who temporarily uses a custom wsl.exe profile with an explicit distribution argument.

title: Screen reader mode drops committed Chinese input
symptom_summary: With screen reader optimization enabled, Sogou Pinyin displays suggestions but the selected text never enters the terminal prompt.
repro_steps: Activate Sogou Pinyin and turn on screen reader optimization in VS Code.
Type a Chinese word in the integrated terminal and confirm a suggestion.

title: Old command output obscures new terminal output
symptom_summary: After using VS Code for a while, running a command can display lines from unrelated command history over the new output. Scrolling up reveals the new output.

title: New PowerShell terminal hangs during Python environment activation
symptom_summary: A newly opened terminal waits until Enter is pressed, and commands sent while it is waiting can be joined into one invalid command.
repro_steps: Open a new terminal.
Observe whether it stays blocked until Enter is pressed.

title: Running a C program freezes the terminal temporarily
symptom_summary: When the reporter runs a C program, the terminal freezes and the program runs about 20 to 30 seconds later.
repro_steps: Run a C program and observe the terminal delay.

title: Integrated terminal shows a blank screen
symptom_summary: The report describes a blank terminal without specifying whether typed characters appear or whether commands run.

title: Blank terminal prevents a program from running
symptom_summary: The terminal stays blank and the reporter cannot run a program despite having installed the compiler and added it to PATH.

title: Integrated terminal does not display typed characters
symptom_summary: The integrated terminal shows a blinking cursor, but typing produces no visible characters. The external Command Prompt accepts input.
repro_steps: Open the integrated terminal on a fresh VS Code installation.
Try to type a command such as dir.

title: Shell integration breaks dead keys in zsh
symptom_summary: With shell integration enabled and a US International keyboard layout, dead key combinations in the integrated terminal produce digits after a regular character is typed.
repro_steps: Enable shell integration and use the US International keyboard layout.
Open a zsh terminal, type a regular character, then try an accent composition.

title: Terminal launch has a transport timing problem
symptom_summary: The report mentions a transport timing issue on terminal launch and gives no further symptom details.

title: Integrated terminal fails to launch after updating to 1.109.0
symptom_summary: Opening the integrated terminal on Windows 10 LTSB 2016 fails after an update or fresh installation of VS Code 1.109.0. The reporter says downgrading to 1.108.2 or earlier removes the error.
repro_steps: Install or update to VS Code 1.109.0.
Open a new integrated terminal.

title: PowerShell shell integration fails when VS Code runs as administrator
symptom_summary: Starting an integrated PowerShell terminal in an administrator session produces a profile error and opens an unexpected VS Code window.
repro_steps: Run VS Code as administrator.
Open an integrated PowerShell terminal.

title: Integrated terminal receives repeated Enter input after update
symptom_summary: After restarting VS Code for an update, the integrated terminal behaves as if Enter is being pressed repeatedly, preventing normal use.
repro_steps: Restart VS Code to complete the update.
Observe input in the integrated terminal.
